messages:
Alex Kim: Heads up — coordinating with CipherCloud on SSO + BYOK KMS integration for marketplace listing. Need SAML metadata exchange and SCIM provisioning plan. Any concerns? :wave:
Maria Chen: Thanks Alex. Do we have a cert timeline from CipherCloud legal? They asked for SOC2 info and a KMS keyflow doc.
Samir Patel: From eng-crypto standpoint, BYOK requirements: we need to support PKCS#11 HSM import + a KMS wrap/unwrap flow. Also need to confirm we can support their key rotation cadence (30/90 days). Ops needs to know network egress for private deployment.
Kevin O'Connor: Partner asks for co-marketing + joint webinar in ~6 weeks. They want a firm go-live window. Feasible?
Alex Kim: Proposed pipeline:
- exchange SAML metadata by Tue
- SCIM mapping doc by next Fri
- KMS handshake PoC start in 2wks.
Can eng sign up for PoC slot? @Samir @Kevin
Samir Patel: I can carve out a PoC slot but need partner test vectors and a test PKCS#11 endpoint (emulator creds). Also want to validate MFA -> SAML assertion mapping for device_id.
Maria Chen: I'll ping legal for SOC2 artifacts and request their KMS flow diagram. Also AWS Marketplace listing requires an owning contact — @partner-eng-liaison can you take listing owner?
partner-eng-liaison: I'll own the marketplace listing. Timeline looks tight but doable. I'll create a consolidated checklist with required items: SAML metadata, SCIM attribute map, BYOK/HSM vendor + API, data residency notes, co-marketing assets. CipherCloud: which HSM vendor and firmware version are you targeting?
marketplace-bot: New marketplace ticket created: MP-2026-1123 — assigned to partner-eng-liaison.
Samir Patel: If vendor is "KeyForge" we have an adapter already; if "VaultX" we'll need to build a PKCS#11 shim. Ask partner for vendor + firmware. Also need partner to provide HSM test certs.
Alex Kim: Action items recap:
- Maria: legal docs (SOC2, KMS keyflow) by EOD Wed
- partner-eng-liaison: create MP checklist + own listing
- Samir: confirm PoC slot + HSM adapter feasibility
- Kevin: align co-marketing dates, hold webinar ask until PoC confirmed
CipherCloud POC contact: elena@ciphercloud.io
We have a SAML metadata template: `https://redwood.internal/docs/saml-template.xml`
Maria Chen: FYI — CipherCloud requested SCIM include "title" and "cost_center". Confirm with partner whether those map to `title` and `division`.
Kevin O'Connor: I'll coordinate with marketing but won't commit to webinar until PoC shows basic BYOK flow.
Alex Kim: Quick sync Thurs 10:00am PT — :thumbsup: if that works.
Samir Patel: :thumbsup:
Maria Chen: :thumbsup:
partner-eng-liaison: :thumbsup:
